knowledge.purpose: Rich long-form body content (Markdown or sanitized HTML) rendered with proper typographic vertical rhythm — the first-party equivalent of a typography/prose plugin, styled entirely from theme tokens
useCases: Article or blog post body bound to a CMS field
Documentation page section with headings, lists, code, and links
Long terms-of-service / policy copy that needs readable rhythm
Documentation with tables, nested steps and code samples a reader copies (copyButton: true)
antiPatterns: A single short line or label — use text.text
Untrusted third-party HTML expecting full passthrough — prose sanitizes to a conservative allowlist (no script/iframe/event handlers)
knowledge.implementation:
Further anti-patterns:
- Interactive form markup — prose strips form/input/button; use form.* blocks

Further use cases:
- Any multi-paragraph rich text where individual text blocks would be tedious
- Code samples: a fenced block names its language after the fence (```ts, ```bash, ```json …); with copyButton: true each block gets a copy button that reads ui.copy / ui.copied (or copyLabel / copiedLabel)

props.name: content
props.description: Markdown string (preferred) OR a raw HTML fragment — content that starts with a tag or closes one () outside code; anything else is Markdown, so a code span naming a tag (`pwf `) or "a folder" stays Markdown. Lines run together into one paragraph until a blank line. Markdown supports headings (#, each with an anchor id from its text (see anchors), unique in the block), nested lists (indent an item under another), GitHub-style tables (| a | b | over |---|---:|, the colons aligning a column), **bold**, *italic*, `code`, fenced code with its language after the fence (```ts — its keywords, strings, numbers and comments coloured from the theme), > blockquote, links and images. A link to an app page (/setup) or an in-page anchor (#options) goes through the app's routing; an outside address is unchanged. HTML is sanitized to a conservative tag/attribute allowlist. Bindable to a data source.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Reading-column max width. Numbers → px; strings (e.g. '65ch', '720px') pass through. Defaults to a readable measure via the layout container token.

props.name: copyButton
props.description: A copy button on each code block, which copies that block's code and announces it. Its words are copyLabel and copiedLabel, else the app's ui.copy and ui.copied.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The copy button's word. Unset: the app's ui.copy. Write it in the app's language.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Shown and announced once the code reached the clipboard. Unset: the app's ui.copied.

props.name: copyButtonReveal
props.description: When the copy button shows: always (default), or only while the pointer is over the code block or the button has focus. On a touch screen it always shows.

props.name: headingLinks
props.description: A # link to itself after each h2–h4 heading, shown on hover, so a reader can copy a section's address. It is a pointer affordance: hidden from screen readers and the tab order (they list the headings already) and from llms-full.txt.

props.name: anchors
props.description: How a heading's anchor is written. compact (default): runs of other characters are one - and a repeat is -2 ("Track A — run" → track-a-run). github: as GitHub and most docs tools write it, so links made for them still land ("Track A — run" → track-a--run, "Apache License 2.0" → apache-license-20, a repeat -1); a non-ASCII letter is spelled in ASCII.

props.name: tableWidth
props.description: How wide a table runs: full (default) the column's width, content as wide as its cells need (a wide one still scrolls inside its box).

tokens.name: h2RuleWidth
tokens.description: Thickness of a line under each h2; 0 draws none.

tokens.name: h2RuleColor
tokens.description: Colour of the line under each h2.

tokens.name: h2RuleGap
tokens.description: Space between an h2 and its line.

tokens.name: listIndent
tokens.description: How far a list sits in from the text.

tokens.name: listLineHeight
tokens.description: Line height in a list item.

tokens.name: inlineCodePaddingBlock
tokens.description: Space above and below inline code, inside its box.

tokens.name: inlineCodePaddingInline
tokens.description: Space left and right of inline code, inside its box.

tokens.name: inlineCodeBorderWidth
tokens.description: Border thickness of inline code; 0 draws none.

tokens.name: codeBlockRadius
tokens.description: Corner radius of a code block.

tokens.name: codeBlockLineHeight
tokens.description: Line height in a code block.

tokens.name: tableCellPaddingBlock
tokens.description: Space above and below a table cell’s text.

tokens.name: tableCellPaddingInline
tokens.description: Space left and right of a table cell’s text.
